title: Configuring Scan Rule for GCP BigQuery

blocks.text: You can configure the scan rule to scan Google Cloud Platform (GCP) BigQuery databases. DSPM scans the database instances for any sensitive data. The scan results are displayed on the Resource Inventory page.
You can configure the scan rule after onboarding the GCP organizations. To learn more, see Onboarding a GCP Organization.
To configure a scan rule for GCP BigQuery databases, complete the following steps in the Zscaler Admin Console:

blocks.item: 1. Provide the general information.
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Scan Settings.
Select the Scan Rules tab.
If you are configuring the scan rule for the first time, the following page appears:
See image.
Click Add Scan Rule.
See image.
The General Information page appears.
On the General Information page:
Scan Rule Name: Enter a unique and descriptive name for the scan rule.
Scan Rule Description (Optional): Enter a description for the scan rule (maximum is 500 characters).
See image.
Click Next.
2. Select the cloud and resource type.
On the Select Cloud and Resource Type page:
For Cloud Type, select Google Cloud.
For Resource Category, select Database.
For the Resource Type, select BigQuery.
See image.
Click Next.
3. Select the projects that must be scanned.
On the Select Resources to Scan page, choose one of the following options:
Scan All Resources: Scans all the projects, BigQuery datasets, and tables across all onboarded projects.
See image.
Scan Specific Resources: Scan only specific projects and BigQuery datasets.
Select Specific Projects and Regions: Select the checkbox for the projects that must be scanned.
Scan Specific BigQuery Datasets: Specify the BigQuery datasets that must be scanned.
Select from the List: Select the checkbox for the datasets that must be scanned from the list. If you choose Manual, enter the datasets names separated by commas.
Select by Labels: Enter the key-value pairs for the datasets. All the datasets that match the label are scanned. Click Add More to add multiple key-value pairs.

If multiple key-value pairs are added, DSPM scans all datasets that match at least one of the specified key-value pairs. This means the rule uses OR logic, and a dataset is included if it matches any of the key-value pairs.
See image.
You can optionally exclude specific datasets from the scan.
Click Next.
4. Exclude BigQuery datasets and tables (Optional).
On the Exclude BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Optional) page, specify the BigQuery datasets and tables that must be excluded from the scan.
If a full scan is already initiated or completed, the datasets and tables are excluded in the next incremental scan.
Enter the datasets and table names separated by commas.

Exclude BigQuery Datasets By Labels: Enable this option and enter the key-value pairs of the datasets that must be excluded from scanning. This option is disabled by default. Click Add More to add multiple key-value pairs.

If multiple key-value pairs are added, DSPM excludes any datasets that matches at least one of the specified key-value pairs. This means the rule uses OR logic, and a dataset is excluded if it matches any of the key-value pairs.
See image.
Click Next.
5. Select the scan type.
On the Scan Type page, select Data Sampling Scan to scan a sample of recent data in the database.
DSPM cannot detect files that are deleted in the GCP console.
See image.
Click Next.
6. Set up the scan schedule.
On the Scan Schedule page, select the scan frequency:
On Demand (Default): The scan runs only when it is initiated manually by the user.
Daily: Scan the data daily.
Weekly: Scan the data once a week. Select the day from the drop-down menu.
Monthly: Scan the data once a month.
See image.
Click Next.
7. Select the scan scope.
On the Scan Scope page, select a scan scope from the drop-down menu for the scan rule.
See image.
Click Next.
8. Review and complete the configuration.
Review the scan rule. Click the Edit icon to change any values, if required.
See image.
Click Finish.

blocks.text: After completing the preceding steps, enable the scan rule on the Scan Settings page to initiate scheduled or on-demand scans.
